learning_outcomes.text: Solve analytical and design problems in physical optics and fiber optics

Understand how photodetectors, LEDs, lasers, and solar cells work, and be able to design simple optoelectronic systems such as fiber optic and free space communication channels, interferometers, simple imaging systems.

syllabus_topics: Nature of Light Conceptual Overview: Wave Equation, Refractive index, group and phase velocity Pointing vector
Nature of Light Conceptual Overview: Snell’s law, Fresnel’s equations, Optical Resonators, Optical Tunneling, Coherence, Diffraction.
Semiconductor Science and Light-Emitting Diodes: semiconductor physics, pn junctions.
Semiconductor Science and Light-Emitting Diodes: Light-emitting diodes and types
Stimulated Emission Devices: Optical Amplifiers and Lasers: Stimulated Emission, Photon Amplification, and Optical amplifiers
Stimulated Emission Devices: Optical Amplifiers and Lasers: Gas Lasers, Laser diodes, quantum well devices
Photodetectors and Image Sensors: pn Junction Photodiode, The pin Photodiode, Avalanche Photodiode
Photodetectors and Image Sensors: Heterojunction Photodiodes, Schottky Junction Photodetector, Phototransistors,
bibliography: Bahaa E. A. SALEH and Malvin C. TEICH, Fundamentals of Photonics, Wiley
S. O. KASAP, Optoelectronics and Photonics: Principles and Practices, Pearson.
